battle.name: 佔領阿勞卡尼亞
battle.theater: 智利南部阿勞卡尼亞邊疆
battle.brief: 一八六一年底起，智利以遠征軍沿比奧比奧河與卡烏廷河之間推進，用堡壘、鐵路與電報一節一節吃掉馬普切人的土地。卡面的線膛野戰砲是這套慢功夫的骨幹火力：射程越過對方的長槍與投石索，讓堡壘可以脫離步兵射程獨立存在，也讓縱隊敢在沒有會戰的情況下繼續往前推。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰方是智利共和國與馬普切諸部聯盟。智利一方由國家直接指揮：國防部轄下的阿勞卡尼亞遠征軍以安戈爾為基地，下轄步兵、騎兵、砲兵、工兵與隨軍醫療隊；一八八一年起內政部接手邊疆事務，由部長曼努埃爾·雷卡巴倫坐鎮安戈爾，南方軍團交給格雷戈里奧·烏魯蒂亞指揮，另設邊境民兵與殖民屯墾機構承擔警戒與後勤。遠征軍後方連通康塞普西翁與聖地牙哥，靠海軍汽船、內河蒸汽船、鐵路與驛馬輸送。馬普切一方沒有常設國家與統一指揮部，靠議會授命戰王，每支部落各有戰士社團與突擊隊，平時耕作、戰時集結；可分為中部低地的阿巴希諾人、西部山前地帶的阿里巴諾人、安第斯山東側的佩溫切人，以及考廷河以南的威利切與湖區各部。阿里巴諾人與佩溫切人自一八七〇年代起得到阿根廷草原聯盟的駿馬與槍械支援，而智利同時還要應付北方對秘魯與玻利維亞的戰事。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Republic of Chile and a coalition of Mapuche groups. The Chilean side was directed by the state itself: the Army of Operations in Araucanía under the Ministry of War used Angol as its base and comprised infantry, cavalry, artillery, engineers and a field medical service; from 1881 the Interior Ministry took over frontier affairs, with the minister Manuel Recabarren based at Angol and the Army of the South handed to Gregorio Urzúa, while frontier militia and the colonisation agency handled local security and supply. The rear of the column was linked to Concepción and Santiago by naval steamers, river steamers on the local waterways, the railway and pack trains. The Mapuche side had no standing state and no unified command; authority was conferred by parliaments upon war leaders, and each group kept its own warriors' societies and mounted raiding bands, farming in peacetime and mustering in war. They fell into the Abajinos of the central lowlands, the Arribanos of the western pre-Andean valleys, the Pehuenches of the eastern Andean slopes, and the Huilliches and the lake districts south of the Cautín river. From the 1870s the Arribanos and Pehuenches drew horses and firearms from the confederation of the Argentine pampas, while Chile was at the same time committed to a war against Peru and Bolivia in the north.
people: 智利方面，主導整場遠征的是科內利奧·薩韋德拉·羅德里格斯。他一八六一年率軍越過比奧比奧河，在穆爾琴與內格雷特設堡，一八六二年以八百名士兵進入安戈爾廢墟重建堡壘；他在安戈爾、托爾滕、伊平科召開的幾次議會，用承認酋長地位、發放俸祿與劃定界線的辦法，把阿巴希諾人與阿里巴諾人拆開，使對方無法合兵。一八六四年他因政界壓力辭職，一八六六年因欽查群島戰爭再度召回，一八七一年再度讓出指揮權。接手的是何塞·曼努埃爾·平托，他在一八六九年春於奇惠埃擊破馬普切主力，一八七〇年五月代表智利正式宣戰，並以焚燒村舍、奪取牲畜的辦法消耗對方。安戈爾的砲兵少校何塞·米格爾·法埃斯留下了一八六一年十二月的內格雷特堡復原圖，是少數可查證的前線工事檔案。馬普切方面，戰王基拉潘是主要敵手，他以數千支長矛維持聯盟，一八七〇年曾在托爾滕議會被說服而孤立；多梅尼科·梅林為談判奔走，一八八〇年在被押往安戈爾途中遭智利軍殺害；維納西奧·科涅潘長期站在智利一方，一八八一年一同抵抗尼耶奧爾堡的圍攻。一八六〇年自立為阿勞卡尼亞及巴塔哥尼亞王國的法國人奧雷利耶-安托萬·德·圖南，一八六二年被智利當局拘捕，後被法庭宣告精神失常並逐回法國，這件事成了遠征的公開理由。
peopleEn: On the Chilean side the driving figure was Cornelio Saavedra Rodríguez. In 1861 he led his troops across the Biobío and established forts at Mulchén and Negrete; in 1862 he took eight hundred men into the ruins of Angol to rebuild the fort. The parliaments he held at Angol, Toltén and Ipinco worked by confirming chiefs in their positions, paying them stipends and drawing lines on the ground, and they split the Abajinos from the Arribanos so that the two could never combine. He resigned in 1864 under political pressure, was recalled in 1866 during the Chincha Islands War, and gave up command once more in 1871. His successor was José Manuel Pinto, who broke a Mapuche force in the mountains of Chihuaihue in the spring of 1869, formally declared war on behalf of Chile in May 1870, and wore the enemy down by burning settlements and seizing livestock. The artillery major José Miguel Fáez of Angol left behind the December 1861 plan for rebuilding the fort of Negrete, one of the few verifiable records of field works from the campaign. On the Mapuche side the main opponent was the war leader Quilapán, who held the coalition together with several thousand lances and was isolated in the parliament of Toltén in 1870; Domingo Melín travelled to seek terms and was killed by Chilean troops in 1880 while being taken to Angol; Venacio Coñoepán stayed on the Chilean side and helped defend the fort of Ñielol during the siege of 1881. The Frenchman Orélie-Antoine de Tounens, who had proclaimed himself king of Araucanía and Patagonia in 1860, was arrested by the Chilean authorities in 1862, was later declared of unsound mind by the Santiago court and expelled to France, and his arrest became the public pretext for the expedition.
kits: 卡面這門一八五〇年式的德國線膛前裝野戰砲，代表智利邊疆砲兵在遠征初年能達到的射程水平。線膛使同樣藥量的炮彈飛得更遠，較大威力的實心球形彈在千二百米以外仍能保持飛行姿態，而滑膛砲的有效射程通常不到九百米；它做不到後膛砲的高膛壓與高射速，因此在十九世紀七〇年代之前仍是最實用的野戰火力。智利遠征軍的砲兵以連為單位，隨縱隊作戰，砲位多設在堡壘背後或高地之上；一八六一年十二月的內格雷特堡圖就出自砲兵少校法埃斯之手。一八八一年十一月十日，特木科堡守軍在無法外出反擊的情況下，用堡內唯一一門砲發射爆炸彈，攻城者在特木科與特魯夫特魯夫一帶傷亡約四百。同一時期智利步兵主力是米涅式步槍，騎兵在一八七一年一月已改配斯賓塞連發卡槍，所以阿里巴諾人衝鋒之後等不到火藥裝填的空檔；到一八七九年智利軍已有十四挺機槍。馬普切方面的火器極少，靠邊境走私取得少量火槍與彈藥，主要武器是長矛、擲木棒、投石索與弓箭，機動力則來自馬匹。補給方面，一八六〇年代起內河蒸汽船投入航線，一八七〇年代鐵路修到安戈爾，電報線沿邊疆一節一節拉開，軍隊口糧與草料有一部分靠奪來的牛羊供應。
kitsEn: The field gun on this card, a German rifled muzzle-loading piece of the 1850s pattern, marks the reach of the Chilean frontier artillery in the early years of the expedition. Rifling carried the same charge of powder much further: the heavier round shot kept its flight well beyond twelve hundred metres, while a smoothbore piece was normally effective at less than nine hundred. It did not bring the high pressure and the high rate of fire of a breechloader, and so until the 1870s it remained the most practical field firepower available. The artillery of the Army of Operations was organised in batteries and marched with the column, with gun positions usually sited behind the forts or on rising ground; the plan for the fort of Negrete of December 1861 was drawn by the artillery major Fáez himself. On 10 November 1881 the garrison of Temuco, unable to sortie, used the only gun in the fort to fire explosive shells at the attackers, and around Temuco and Truf Truf the Mapuche fighters suffered about four hundred casualties that day. In the same period the Chilean infantry carried Minié rifles and, by January 1871, the cavalry had been re-equipped with Spencer repeating carbines, so an Arribano charge no longer met an empty weapon; by 1879 the Chilean army already had fourteen machine guns. The Mapuche had very few firearms, obtaining a few muskets and scarce ammunition by smuggling across the frontier; their main weapons were the long lance, the throwing club, the sling and the bow, and mobility came from horses. On the logistics side, river steamers began to work the local waterways in the 1860s, the railway reached Angol in the 1870s, and telegraph lines were strung along the frontier stage by stage; rations and fodder for the troops were met in part from cattle and sheep taken in the raids.
tactics: 智利方的打法是築堡加縱隊：每年在南半球夏季出兵，先從上一年的據點向前推進一線，再修土木寨與砲位，把堡壘、屯田、鐵路與電報一節一節往前接，任務不是會戰，而是讓國界一年比一年靠近。進攻時由騎兵擔任前哨與搜索，步兵縱隊沿海陸兩條邊界分進合擊，砲兵在縱隊之前先射，把對方從能居高臨下的山頭上趕下來；遇到游擊就停下來設堡，把對方反過來困在堡與堡之間。對付馬普切最有效的手段並非正面交戰，而是分化：一八六七年、一八六九年十二月二十四日托爾滕、一八七〇年一月十九日伊平科這幾次議會，把承認邊界、允許遷徙、交換俘虜與發放報酬寫成條件，藉此拆散阿里巴諾人與阿巴希諾人的聯盟，並把威利切各部拉到智利一方。馬普切的戰術則是游擊與騎兵突擊的配合：集結數百上千名騎手與長矛兵越過納韋爾布塔山脈，突入邊境聚落奪取牲畜後立即退回山區，並避免與裝備連發卡槍的智利騎兵正面對撞；一八七〇年之後他們更常主動退開，把智利軍引向空地。一八八一年起義原訂十一月五日同時發動，結果阿里巴諾人提前在十一月三日誤攻基列姆堡而暴露，讓所有守軍得以及時加固，圍攻特木科與尼耶奧爾的行動因此失敗。
tacticsEn: The Chilean method was a fort plus a column. Each southern summer the army came out, pushed the line forward by one stage from the previous year's posts, then built earth redoubts and gun positions, and joined fort, farm, railway and telegraph together stage by stage; the object was not a decisive battle but to bring the border of the republic nearer every year. Cavalry did the reconnaissance and the screening, infantry columns advanced by the coastal and the inland lines at once, and the guns fired ahead of the infantry to drive the enemy off the heights from which they could fire down. When the enemy resorted to harassment the column halted and built a fort instead, trapping the raiders between one fort and the next. The most effective instrument against the Mapuche was not open battle but a policy of division. The parliaments of 1867, of Toltén on 24 December 1869 and of Ipinco on 19 January 1870 turned the recognition of borders, permission to move, exchange of prisoners and payment of rewards into written conditions, and so they broke the alliance between the Arribanos and the Abajinos and drew the Huilliches to the Chilean side. The Mapuche method was mounted raid and harassment in combination: several hundred to a thousand riders and lancers crossed the Nahuelbuta range, struck the frontier settlements, took cattle and withdrew again into the mountains, and avoided meeting Chilean cavalry armed with repeating carbines in open combat. After 1870 they grew still more inclined to give way, drawing the Chilean column into empty ground. The rising of 1881 was set for 5 November, but the Arribanos struck the fort of Quillem by mistake on 3 November and gave the whole movement away, allowing every garrison to strengthen in time; the siege of Temuco and the fort of Ñielol failed as a result.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個節點上。遠征第一年，一八六二年進入安戈爾廢墟的智利軍為八百人；一八六三年安戈爾已集中一千五百人以上，準備向內陸作戰。對方兵力按來源差距很大：一八六七年智利召集的議會有約一千名阿巴希諾人出席，聚集在外的阿里巴諾人約兩千；一八六七年十二月奇惠埃山區曾聚集四千至五千名戰士，來自莫克埃瓦、博羅阿與拉伊姆佩里亞爾；一八六八年基拉潘一度企圖聯合阿巴希諾人與威利切人湊出八千支長矛，被薩韋德拉以議會分化，最後只剩阿里巴諾人自籌的兩千五百支。損失方面，一八六八年兩支前往克切雷瓜斯的智利小隊在途中遭襲，其中一支二十八人被擊斃二十三人；一八六九年一月底平托在奇惠埃擊破一千五百名馬普切戰士；同年夏智利軍在掃蕩中掠走牲畜逾二百萬頭；一八七〇年五月正式宣戰；一八七一年一月二十五日，三千支長矛的聯軍在科利普利與二千五百名智利軍交戰，智利騎兵以斯賓塞連發卡槍擊退對方，此後戰事停歇十年。一八八〇年九月近千名戰士攻擊特拉伊圭，一八八一年一月底馬萊科地區再度起義，特拉伊圭、盧馬科、科利普利同時遇襲；同年二月智利在考廷河畔建起特木科堡，三月二十八日建立維多利亞鎮；起義方傷亡約七百餘人，另有三百餘人受傷，十一月十日特木科一役的傷亡約四百人，十一月二十二日開始在安卡米利亞舊址興建喬爾喬爾堡。軍械方面，一八七九年智利軍已配備十四挺機槍；阿勞卡尼亞境內的馬普切與佩溫切人口估計逾十萬；一八八三年一月一日比亞里卡復設，同年六月一日總統宣布全區平定。安置方面，馬普切人口被壓縮到約三千份王室授地證涵蓋的五十萬公頃，國家每月發放近一萬份口糧直至一九〇〇年前後；殖民統計則有一八八六年前三千五百零一名外來殖民者，一八八三至一八九〇年間五千六百五十七人。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around a few dates. In the first year of the expedition the Chilean force that entered the ruins of Angol in 1862 numbered eight hundred men; by 1863 more than fifteen hundred were concentrated at Angol ready to operate inland. Estimates of the enemy vary widely by source: about a thousand Abajinos attended the parliament Chile called in 1867, with some two thousand Arribanos massed outside; in December 1867 four to five thousand fighters had gathered in the mountains of Chihuaihue, from Moquehua, Boroa and La Imperial; in 1868 Quilapán tried to join the Abajinos and Huilliches to raise more than eight thousand lances, and the parliaments of Saavedra broke that up, leaving Quilapán with the twenty-five hundred lances the Arribanos could raise on their own. On losses, in 1868 two Chilean detachments heading for Quechereguas were ambushed on the way and one of them lost twenty-three men out of twenty-eight; at the end of January 1869 Pinto broke a Mapuche force of fifteen hundred at Chihuaihue; in the summer of the same year the Chilean army took more than two million head of livestock in its sweeps; war was formally declared in May 1870; and on 25 January 1871 a coalition of three thousand lances met twenty-five hundred Chilean soldiers at Collipulli, where cavalry armed with Spencer repeating carbines turned the Mapuche back, after which the fighting stopped for ten years. In September 1880 close to a thousand fighters attacked Traiguén, and in late January 1881 the Malleco area rose again, hitting Traiguén, Lumaco and Collipulli together; in February of that year Chile raised the fort of Temuco on the Cautín river and on 28 March founded the town of Victoria. The rising cost the Mapuche some seven hundred dead and three hundred wounded, of whom about four hundred were killed or wounded in the engagement at Temuco on 10 November, and building of the fort of Cholchol on the site of the ruka of Ancamilla began on 22 November. In weapons, the Chilean army had fourteen machine guns by 1879; the Mapuche and Pehuenche population of Araucanía was estimated at over a hundred thousand. The formal end came with the refounding of Villarrica on 1 January 1883 and the declaration of 1 June that the whole area was pacified. On settlement, the Mapuche were compressed onto roughly five hundred thousand hectares covered by some three thousand merced grants, and the state issued close to ten thousand rations a month until around 1900; the colonial statistics record three thousand five hundred and one foreign settlers by 1886 and five thousand six hundred and fifty-seven arrivals between 1883 and 1890.
cause: 動因是經濟的、地緣的與政治的疊加。阿勞卡尼亞的畜牧業與耕地在十九世紀中葉成為智利中部以外唯一能大規模擴張的土地，連接中部與南方的鐵路必須穿過比奧比奧河，而抵達洛塔羅與瓦爾迪維亞的移民和貨運都要從這片名義上屬於智利、實際上由馬普切各部自治的土地經過，國家領土被從中間切斷；加上邊境持續出現偷牲畜、擄人與襲擾屯莊的事件，軍方多次出兵，最後決定直接劃界。直接的口實來自一八六〇年：法國人奧雷利耶-安托萬·德·圖南在阿勞卡尼亞自立為王，一八六二年被智利拘捕，使原本模糊的邊界問題變成國家主權問題，軍方得以把遠征說成是收復領土。制度層面上，智利在一八二五年的塔皮韋議會曾與馬普切約定邊界與通行權，但共和國議會未予批准，此後每一次徵召兵役、每一次開闢道路都會重新挑動摩擦；一八五一年推翻曼努埃爾·布爾內斯政府的起義與一八五九年自由派起義都曾有馬普切盟友參與，留下未清的政治舊帳。最後是技術與理論的推力：連發槍、機槍、後膛砲、蒸汽船與電報都已在別處證明能壓過騎兵游擊，智利把這些裝備視為解決邊疆的必要條件。
causeEn: The causes were economic, geographic and political at once. The pastoral and farming lands of Araucanía were, in the middle of the nineteenth century, the only place where Chile could still expand on a large scale, and the railway linking the centre of the country with the south had to cross the Biobío; the immigrants and the freight bound for Lota, Valdivia and the far south all passed through land that was nominally Chilean but in practice autonomous under Mapuche control, and the republic was cut in two by its own frontier. Add to that the repeated cattle theft, the seizures of people and the raids on outlying settlements, which had already forced the government to deploy troops several times, and the decision to draw the line outright became inevitable. The immediate occasion came in 1860: the Frenchman Orélie-Antoine de Tounens proclaimed himself king in Araucanía and was arrested by Chile in 1862, which turned a vague frontier question into a question of national sovereignty and let the army present the expedition as a recovery of territory. At the institutional level, the parliament of Tapihue of 1825 had fixed a border and a right of passage between the republic and the Mapuche, but the Chilean congress never ratified it, and every later conscription and every new road reopened the friction; the rising of 1851 against Bulnes and the liberal rising of 1859 both drew Mapuche allies and left old political accounts unsettled. Finally there was the push of technology and of doctrine: repeating carbines, machine guns, breechloaders, steamships and the telegraph had already shown elsewhere that they could beat mounted irregulars, and Chile treated that equipment as a condition for finishing the frontier.
impact: 這場遠征改變了智利的國土形狀，也改變了南美洲邊疆戰爭的樣子。疆土上，比奧比奧河與考廷河之間的土地被正式劃入國家版圖，鐵路沿著新建的堡壘與城鎮鋪開，安戈爾、特木科、維多利亞、勞塔羅、萊布、托爾滕等地相繼成為節點，原先把國家切開的地理阻隔就此打通；地方經濟也從放牧轉向耕作與伐木。對馬普切而言，遠征之後土地被大幅壓縮，僅餘約三千份授地證所涵蓋的五十萬公頃，其餘落入智利與歐洲移民手中，許多人轉往阿根廷境內尋找工作地；阿根廷同時在潘帕斯與巴塔哥尼亞推動的征服沙漠，又把一批馬普切人趕過馬穆伊爾山隘遷往庫拉考科河谷。軍事技術上，這是十九世紀少數把後膛砲、機槍、連發卡槍、內河汽船、鐵路與電報合在一起使用的邊疆戰役，後來智利在安第斯山區與秘魯邊境、阿根廷在草原的行動都沿用同一套模式：以堡壘為支點、以鐵路延伸補給、以火力和機動力壓過對方騎兵。阿勞卡尼亞王國的傳說則在後世成為象徵，一八八〇年代法國還出現過自稱王的可笑人物，兩側輿論至今仍用它來談歷史中的主權與外來干預。
impactEn: This expedition changed the shape of the republic and the pattern of frontier warfare in South America. Territorially, the land between the Biobío and the Cautín was drawn into the national map, the railway was pushed along the new forts and towns, and Angol, Temuco, Victoria, Lautaro, Lebu and Toltén became nodes, so that the geographic barrier which had cut the country in half was opened at last; locally the economy shifted from herding towards farming and timber. For the Mapuche the land was reduced drastically afterwards, to some five hundred thousand hectares covered by about three thousand merced grants, while the rest passed to Chilean and European settlers, and many families crossed the Andes eastwards in search of work; the Argentine campaigns in the pampas and in Patagonia in the same years pushed further groups of Mapuche over the Mamuil pass into the valley of the Curaucó. Technologically this was one of the few nineteenth-century frontier wars fought with breechloading guns, machine guns, repeating carbines, river steamers, railway and telegraph used together, and the same model was followed by Chile in the Andean interior and on the Peruvian border, and by Argentina in the pampas. The legend of the Kingdom of Araucanía survived as a symbol; in the 1880s men who styled themselves king still appeared in France, and the story is used on both sides of the continent to talk about sovereignty and foreign intervention in history.
result: 結果是智利軍用二十二年的時間完成了佔領。一八八一年十一月的起義是馬普切最後一次大規模協同反攻：原訂十一月五日同時攻擊各處堡壘，卻因阿里巴諾人提前在三日誤攻基列姆而暴露，攻盧馬科、托爾滕、特拉伊圭與普倫各線多告失敗；圍攻尼耶奧爾堡與特木科堡的部隊未能攻破，防守方以步槍、機槍與堡內唯一一門砲的爆炸彈把攻城者擋在牆外，起義者傷亡約七百人。首領路易斯·馬里萊奧·科利皮、米拉潘、揚科、埃斯特萬·羅梅羅與安卡米利亞在失敗後被逐一追究，安卡米利亞被戴上手銬押往波布萊特監獄，喬爾喬爾堡就建在他原居的魯卡之上。一八八二年夏智利再出動縱隊進入安第斯山區，在隆基梅河谷建起尼特里托堡，在萊艾馬火山附近建昆科，在考廷河上游建庫拉考廷，切斷馬普切人橫越山脈的通路。一八八三年一月一日比亞里卡復設，標誌佔領程序完成；同年六月一日總統多明戈·聖瑪麗亞宣布整個阿勞卡尼亞已平定，馬普切的武裝抵抗從此瓦解，各部被約束在授地證劃定的範圍內，邊疆進入以行政與警察為主的管制時期，直到二十世紀末仍有零星暴力與執行不公的申訴留下未清的帳。
resultEn: In the end Chile took twenty-two years to complete the occupation. The rising of November 1881 was the last large coordinated counter-stroke by the Mapuche: the plan was to strike the forts simultaneously on 5 November, but the Arribanos struck the fort of Quillem by mistake on 3 November and exposed the movement, the lines against Lumaco, Toltén, Traiguén and Purén failed, and the besiegers of the forts of Ñielol and Temuco could not break in, the defenders meeting them from the walls with rifles, machine guns and the one gun in the fort firing explosive shells. The rising cost the Mapuche some seven hundred dead. Its leaders Luis Marileo Colipí, Millapán, Ñanco, Esteban Romero and Ancamilla were each called to account after the defeat; Ancamilla was taken prisoner and sent in handcuffs to the dungeons of Poblete, and the fort of Cholchol was raised on the site of his old ruka. In the summer of 1882 the Chileans sent columns into the Andes again, raising the fort of Nitrito in the valley of the Lonquimay, Cunco near the Llaima volcano and Curacautín on the upper Cautín, and so cutting the paths by which the Mapuche crossed the range. On 1 January 1883 Villarrica was refounded, closing the formal process of occupation; on 1 June of the same year the president Domingo Santa María declared the whole of Araucanía pacified. The armed resistance of the Mapuche was broken, the groups were confined to the areas marked out by the merced grants, and the frontier passed over to a regime of administration and police, whose uneven justice is still argued over at the end of the century.
